title: Venus Incident
description: An analysis of the February 27, 2025 wUSDM exchange-rate manipulation on Venus zkSync, which left about $902K in bad debt and about $716K in net loss after recoveries.

title: Building the IT Function at Physical Control Center Inc.: A Founding CTO’s Account
description: A founding CTO’s account of building PCC’s technical foundation from the ground up, covering the tech stack, systems, and responsibilities behind my work.

title: TradeXYZ Incident
description: An analysis of the July 28, 2026 TradeXYZ SKHX mark-price incident, estimated to have liquidated $57.4M in long positions and caused $17.3M in realized losses.

title: COLDCARD Incident
description: An analysis of the July 30, 2026 COLDCARD seed-generation vulnerability linked to 1,367.05 BTC (~$88.6M at the time) in reported losses, its attack path, root causes, and defensive opportunities.

title: JaredFromSubway MEV Bot 2 Incident Analysis
description: An analysis of the June 20, 2026 exploit against the jaredfromsubway MEV Bot 2 through attacker-controlled routes and lingering token approvals.

title: The Zcash Orchard Counterfeiting Vulnerability and the Redefinition of Cybersecurity by AI
description: An analysis of the Zcash Orchard vulnerability discovered on May 29, 2026, and what AI-assisted discovery means for security work.

title: Kelp DAO Incident Analysis
description: An analysis of the April 18, 2026 Kelp DAO rsETH bridge exploit involving LayerZero message verification and response.

title: Resolv USR Incident Analysis
description: An analysis of the March 22, 2026 Resolv USR exploit, covering privileged settlement, root cause, and response.

title: Differential Privacy in the U.S. and Japan
description: A review of why differential privacy became controversial in the U.S. Census context and how that differs from Japan.

title: OSCP
description: A compact OSCP scope covering footholds, privilege escalation, pivoting, and Active Directory.

title: Integration of PSI-CA and Differential Privacy for APPI Compliance
description: Work notes on the academic paper combining PSI-CA and differential privacy for APPI compliance.
